bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and culture; appropriating money for Capital City youth art and culture initiatives.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; CAPITAL CITY YOUTH INITIATIVES.

$500,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Capitol Area Architectural and Planning Board for Capital City youth art and culture initiatives.
